processors.title: Agent (Claude, Codex, Pi, OpenCode)
processors.description: The coding agent an agent plugin supplies. It starts when the session does, takes one message a turn, and reports what it does through the host the core hands it (AgentHost, src/plugins/host/agents.ts). The core names no agent.

commands.title: Record Agent Output

fields.name: output
fields.example: assistant message, tool result, result, ready

commands.description: What a provider may put in the log itself: the agent's own output (AgentOutput in src/server/agentTypes.ts), and that it is ready or that its turn ended. No HTTP route — the provider calls the host in process.

events.title: Agent Ready
events.description: A `status` event with status "idle" (or "running" when the first turn is already under way), carrying the agent's own session id, its model, the account it spends, its tools and slash commands.

events.title: Agent Replied
events.description: The log's `assistant` event: one message of the agent's turn, as blocks of text, thinking and tool calls. `text_delta` and `thinking_delta` events stream it before it is whole.

events.title: Tool Result Recorded
events.description: The log's `tool_result` event: what a tool call the agent made came back with.

events.title: Turn Ended
events.description: The log's `result` event, then a `status` back to "idle" unless a waiting message goes out. A turn that could not start is a `note` with code "api" instead.

processors.title: Permission gate
processors.description: The agent's own gate: in the session's mode, a tool call the mode does not let through is put to the user before it runs. A provider with no gate never asks.

commands.title: Request Permission
commands.description: requestPermission in src/server/agentChat.ts, called by the provider. A session that has ended answers deny at once, and nothing is recorded.

events.title: Permission Requested
events.description: The log's `permission_request` event; the session becomes awaiting_input until every open request is answered.

commands.title: Answer Permission

fields.name: message

commands.description: answerPermission. A deny with no reason tells the agent "Denied in SpecDriven"; remember only counts when the agent suggested a rule. Refused with a 404 when the request has already been answered.

events.title: Permission Answered
events.description: The log's `permission_resolved` event. `via` says who closed the card: the user, a stop ("interrupt"), or the session ending ("ended"). With no request left open the session is running again.

commands.title: Stop Turn
commands.description: interruptChat. Refused with a 409 when nothing is running, or when the agent cannot be interrupted. The agent stays up for the next message, and messages that waited keep waiting: a Stop starts nothing.

events.description: A `note` event with code "interrupted": "Stopped." for the Stop button, "Stopped for your message." for Send now. Every open permission request is answered deny, via "interrupt", first.

processors.description: Runs when a session that was started in a git worktree of its own ends (cleanUpWorktree, src/server/agentWorktree.ts).

commands.title: Clean Up Worktree

events.title: Worktree Kept
